value.title: Complete Movie
value.synopsis: The plot of the film was described as a "reconstruction" on the events of the 2021 series, according to a press release by Famitsu, with a depiction of the events which take place after the series finale. The plot of the original series focuses on Odokawa, a middle-aged walrus taxi driver, whose interactions with his customers entangle him into a recent disappearance of a girl.
